about: Electro-chemical etch marker: a bench power unit (blue steel wrap cover, a moulded bezel round a recessed black-anodised panel carrying a panel meter, the voltage knob and its scale, an AC/DC toggle, the lit power rocker and the red and black output jacks, lettered; a fold-down handle, rubber feet), the marking head standing on its felt pad (electrode, ribbed grip, trigger), the red lead to it, the black ground lead and its clip, a yellow stencil with a part number cut in it and a squeeze bottle of electrolyte. Self-made in Blender (sources/etch/build_etch.py) where the placeholder (planner.placeholders.etch_marker) has its boxes.
reviewed: 2026-11-05: modelled; look sheets and three.js before/after checked

source.made: self-made in Blender from public dimensions and photos; build script and .blend beside it

etch_case_blue.about: the power unit's wrap cover: blue powder-coated steel

etch_panel.about: black anodised aluminium: the front and rear panels

etch_white.about: panel lettering, the meter's scale, the felt pad, the electrolyte bottle

etch_red.about: the red lead, its plug and jack, the power rocker and the bottle's nozzle

etch_stencil.about: a marking stencil: yellow film over its backing

sources_used: the record (AC dark mark / DC etch, 0-25 V) and its placeholder for every part's position

electrochemical marking kits (Etch-O-Matic at Penn Tool Co.; Lectroetch, Monode style units): a power unit with voltage control and AC/DC selection, a hand marking head with a felt pad, a ground lead or plate, stencils and electrolyte
US patent 4408215 (electrochemical marking apparatus): head, felt wicking pad, stencil, grounded work

unsure.what: a generic unit: no maker named in the record, so the panel layout, colours and the 'ETCH-MARK' lettering are invented
